'''QuTiP: Open Quantum System Dynamics'''
[[Category:Principia Machina]] [[Category:Tools]]

== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
'''QuTiP''' (Quantum Toolbox in Python) is an open-source framework for simulating the dynamics of open quantum systems, operator algebras, and quantum state vectors.

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM & SVD ==
* '''Operator & Density Matrix Dynamics (8.5/10):''' Solves non-commuting operator relations, Lindblad master equations, and Hamiltonian state evolutions in Hilbert space.
* '''Quantum-Classical Interface:''' Provides the quantum reference framework for testing whether SVD vacuum state fluctuations match open quantum master equations.
